subject: Launch Commitment Canvas — Luminary Health kickoff
messages:
From: Carlos Rios <carlos.rios@luminaryhealth.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.inference.io
Date: Sun, 7 Sep 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick kickoff sync + success criteria

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was really impressed with the latency profile and the private deployment options. We have executive buy-in to move forward but would like a short, action-oriented plan that lays out milestones, owners, and acceptance checks so we can align our internal launch calendar (Q4).

High level asks from our side:
- A compact list of milestones with dates and single accountable owner from Redwood and Luminary.
- Risk flags (data migrations, SSO, latency SLAs) and fallback steps.
- A target date for pilot completion and production cutover.

Can you share a one-page canvas or lanecard and proposed owners by Tuesday? Procurement may need the commercial timeline as well — cc'ing procurement@luminaryhealth.com.

Appreciate it,
Carlos
VP Product, Luminary Health

[Attachment: none]
From: irene_choi@redwood.inference.io
To: Carlos Rios <carlos.rios@luminaryhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.inference.io, ben_carter@redwood.inference.io
Date: Mon, 8 Sep 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick kickoff sync + success criteria

Carlos — thanks for the clear asks. I sketched a "Launch Commitment Canvas" (attached) that maps milestones, acceptance criteria, owners and a suggested timeline. Marissa (CS Lead) and Ben (Implementation Manager) are looped in to commit owners and surface any technical risks.

Summary of what you'll find in the canvas:
- Launch lanes: Pilot (4 weeks), Integration & SSO (2 weeks parallel), Performance validation (2 weeks), Prod cutover (target: 2025-11-12).
- Owners: Redwood PM for feature flags (Irene), CS lead for onboarding tasks (Marissa), Implementation engineer for infra and provisioning (Ben), Luminary infra lead for network/tests (Carlos).
- Acceptance checks: end-to-end smoke test pass, 99th pctl latency under 400ms on representative set, SSO validation with test users.
- Known risks: customer firewall rules, data model mapping for embedding metadata, DocuSign timeline.

Attaching Launch_Commitment_Canvas_v1.xlsx and a sidecar network diagram. Can Marissa confirm the operational checkpoints and Ben confirm provisioning lead times so we can finalize dates?

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Launch_Commitment_Canvas_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Network_Architecture_Sidecar.pdf (diagram)]
From: marissa_cole@redwood.inference.io
To: irene_choi@redwood.inference.io, Carlos Rios <carlos.rios@luminaryhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.inference.io
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick kickoff sync + success criteria

On Mon, Sep 8, 2025 at 09:05, irene_choi@redwood.inference.io wrote:
> Attaching Launch_Commitment_Canvas_v1.xlsx and a sidecar network diagram.

Thanks Irene — I reviewed the canvas and proposed the following concrete commitment rows (below). If Luminary confirms owners on their side I can build the MAP into our onboarding tracker and set weekly checkpoints.

Proposed commitment rows (owner — target date — acceptance):
- Sandbox provisioning — Ben (Redwood Infra) — 2025-09-22 — sandbox reachable, test tokens provisioned to Luminary engineers.
- SSO test accounts & SCIM sync — Luminary IdP lead (Carlos will name) — 2025-09-29 — 2 test users authenticated, SCIM provisioning creates groups.
- Data ingest & schema sign-off — Luminary engineering (Carlos) + Redwood integration engineer (Ben) — 2025-10-06 — sample dataset ingested, embeddings match schema and sample queries pass.
- Performance validation (representative QPS) — Performance team (Marissa lead) — 2025-10-20 — 99th pctl < 400ms, baseline cost report generated.
- Pilot close & acceptance — Luminary Product + Redwood CS — 2025-11-03 — pilot acceptance form completed and OK from Luminary PM.
- Production cutover (soft) — All parties — 2025-11-12 — feature flags enabled, monitoring runbook activated.

Operational checkpoints I propose: weekly 30-min sync (Wednesdays 10am PT), a shared tracker (I'll create), and an escalation path (Ben -> Irene -> Marissa). I added a column in the canvas for "blockers" and "mitigation".

Ben, any concerns on provisioning lead times?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

Irene / Marissa,

Procurement here. We have a shortened contracting window and would like to complete signatures by 2025-10-01 to align with our internal vendor onboarding. Please confirm:

- Is the SOW versioned? We saw an older SOW in the portal; please send the latest and a DocuSign link.

We attached our vendor checklist and a requested redline (pdf). If signatures are completed by 2025-10-01 we can proceed to create staging VPCs the week of 2025-10-06.

Procurement Team
Luminary Health

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.inference.io, ben_carter@redwood.inference.io
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick kickoff sync + success criteria — confirmation & next steps

Thanks everyone — quick summary and confirmed next steps from Redwood: 

1) Contracts: We'll circulate SOW_v3 (with the commercial appendix) via DocuSign today. Target sign-by date: 2025-09-30 to give ops one business day before your requested 2025-10-01 window.
2) Provisioning: Ben will schedule sandbox provisioning for 2025-09-22 and share access tokens. Ben, please flag if any infra lead time pushes that date.
3) SSO & SCIM: Carlos to confirm IdP contact by 2025-09-12. Luminary will run the first round of SSO tests by 2025-09-29.
4) Data ingest: Sample dataset and mapping template requested from Luminary by 2025-09-19.
5) Weekly cadence: First checkpoint Wednesday 2025-09-10 at 10:00 AM PT (30m). I'll send calendar invites and a shared tracker link.

Risks called out: network ACLs are the highest near-term dependency — see the Network_Architecture_Sidecar.pdf attached earlier. If procurement needs a revised payment term confirmation we can loop in Finance but can likely accept 30-day net.

I'll follow up with the calendar and tracker link in a separate email. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: SOW_v3.pdf (DocuSign to follow)]
